other_failure_modes.description: The agent pre-computes out-of-fold features (like target encoding and Ridge predictions) on the training set using K-Fold, then uses these as static features in a subsequent cross-validation loop with identical folds (same random seed). This causes the target values of each validation fold to leak into its respective training features, severely biasing the model and invalidating the CV scores.

summary: The agent implements a highly sophisticated pipeline with thorough feature engineering, deep learning, and Nelder-Mead rank blending. However, the solution contains a critical target leakage flaw: out-of-fold features (target encodings and Ridge predictions) are generated and then reused as features in a subsequent cross-validation loop that uses the exact same folds. This contaminates the training set of each fold with information from its validation set. Additionally, there is minor data leakage from fitting LabelEncoders on the combined train and test sets.
